messages:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard model q4b-v2-qat tomorrow morning (09:30 PST). We need a dedupe + golden-sample refresh for summarization + extractive QA prior to canary. Short list of asks below.

Neil: ok — what dedupe metric? sha1 exact or semantic simhash? also shard sizes?

Sasha: semantic first (faiss + cosine) then exact hash pass for obvious duplicates. Target threshold 0.86 cosine, 100k seed shard size. rough command:
```
python tools/dedupe.py --emb-index faiss_ivf --threshold 0.86 --shard-size 100000 --out=deduped/qd2
```

Maria: @Sasha we'll freeze new labeling for cohorts: summa_v2, qa_long. Need golden pool of 600 samples (300 summa, 300 qa) pulled from deduped+stratified by length and domain. Also request 50 adversarial edgecases from previous regressions.

Neil: I can run the stratified sample script. Will tag by domain meta and length bins. Plan:
- build deduped set
- stratify into bins
- sample seed + jitter

Ash: can you add a small notebook with sampling code? I don't want surprises in the canary.

Sasha: yep, I'll drop a notebook in /s3/redwood-curation/q4b/onboard-notebook.ipynb after first dedupe run. Also need to run quantization smoke for 4-bit profile — expecting minor tokenization regressions in long ctx.

Lee: note that in prior q-quant rolls we saw a 0.8% exact-match drop on extractive QA with 4-bit. Recommend adding a tiny A/B eval: run new model with full-precision on the golden 600 for baseline and the quantized variant; check EM and F1 deltas. If delta > 0.5% flag for human review.

qa-bot: automated-eval completed on staging for q4b-v1-qat — summary EM delta vs baseline: +0.1%, mean gen-len +2 tokens. full report: https://internal/reports/q4b-v1-qat/summary

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for q4b-v2-qat at 2026-03-21T17:30Z. Will only route 2% traffic. Use rollback tag `canary/quv2`.

Maria: labeling plan ok. I'll allocate 6 labelers for 48 hours for golden review + 1 lead for adjudication. will post consolidated checklist.

Sasha: thanks everyone. Neil — can you aim to have dedupe + stratified sample by 09:00 PST tomorrow? If yes I'll kick the quant smoke and notebook. :thumbsup:

Neil: yes — starting now. I'll ping when dedupe/manifest ready (will include sample counts per domain).

Sasha: perfect. closing loop here — I'll create the follow-up ticket and tag the golden sample artifact once live.
